question: Annu Rani Wins Javelin Gold at Poland Meet 2025 with _________________ Throw.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**62.59m**__.

 
• Annu Rani Wins Javelin Gold at Poland Meet with 62.59m Throw.

 
• 
 
**Annu Rani** won **gold** in **women’s javelin throw** in **Poland**.

 
 
• 
 
Event was held at the **International Wiesław Maniak Memorial**.

 
 
• 
 
She threw a **season-best 62.59 meters** in her **second attempt**.

 
 
• 
 
Her first throw of **60.96m** was enough to secure **first place**.

 
 
• 
 
**Eda Tugsuz (Turkey)** won **silver** with a **58.36m** throw.

 
 
• 
 
**Lianna Davidson (Australia)** won **bronze** with **58.24m**.

 
 
• 
 
**Pooja** secured **third place** in **women’s 800m** with **2:02.95**.
